correctness.rationale: Every primal vertex has two coordinate levels indexed by a nonempty proper S, with high c/[m+(c-1)|S|] and low 1/[m+(c-1)|S|]. All polar vertices are the facet normals a_ij; polar facets F_S decompose orthogonally as scaled simplices of dimensions k-1 and m-k-1, with exact product volume. Their supporting heights are [m+(c-1)k]sqrt(m)/((c-1)sqrt(k(m-k))); origin pyramids partition the polar, giving the binomial sum with intrinsic dimension m-1 and all endpoints. The primal fraction follows from exponential order-statistic integral; permutation symmetry singles out the Santaló center. Independently evaluated c=2 polar values 117sqrt(3)/2 at m=3 and 1344 at m=4 and products 351/40, 64/5; verified exact rational formula. Real c>1 justified by geometric argument, not finite checks.
